_comment: MEDIUM tier of the Cloud SQL CUJ set (Google-managed MCP vs gcloud-only).

scenarios.starting_prompt: Create a new database called 'analytics' on the Cloud SQL instance 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation, then confirm it exists.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to create database 'analytics' on my-pg-app-bbf9a3 and verify. Success = the database 'analytics' is created on my-pg-app-bbf9a3 by ANY valid means (MCP execute_sql 'CREATE DATABASE', or `gcloud sql databases create`) AND its existence is confirmed. Do not require a specific tool.

The user starts vague. You want a NEW database named 'user_data' created on the EXISTING instance 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation. If the agent asks which instance, say my-pg-app-bbf9a3. If it asks the database name, say 'user_data'. Do NOT ask it to create a new instance. Success = the agent creates database 'user_data' on my-pg-app-bbf9a3 by ANY valid means (MCP execute_sql or `gcloud sql databases create`); do not require a specific tool.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Add a database user named 'app_ro' to 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation for a reporting tool.
scenarios.conversation_plan: The user wants a new user 'app_ro' created on my-pg-app-bbf9a3. If the agent asks for a password, provide any reasonable value. Success = the agent creates the user 'app_ro' on the instance (create_user).

scenarios.starting_prompt: Set the 'max_connections' database flag to 100 on 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation and then show me that it took effect.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to set the max_connections flag to 100 on my-pg-app-bbf9a3 and verify. Success = the agent updates the instance's database flags (update_instance) AND confirms the new value by ANY valid means -- either reading the instance config back (get_instance) OR querying the live running value (e.g. execute_sql_readonly with 'SHOW max_connections' / a pg_settings query). Do not require a specific verification tool; reading the live value is an equally (or more) valid confirmation than get_instance.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Resize 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation up to the 'db-g1-small' tier, then confirm the new tier.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to change the tier of my-pg-app-bbf9a3 to db-g1-small and verify. Success = the agent updates the tier (update_instance) AND reads it back to confirm db-g1-small. Teardown resets the tier to db-f1-micro afterward.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Shrink the disk on 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation from its current size down to 5GB.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Cloud SQL does not allow shrinking disk (it can only grow). Success = the agent recognizes the constraint and explains it cannot reduce disk size (optionally after inspecting the instance with get_instance), and does NOT push through a doomed update.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Bump the instance 'non-existent-db-123' in astana-evaluation up to 8 vCPUs.
scenarios.conversation_plan: The instance 'non-existent-db-123' does not exist. The agent should attempt to look it up or change it, discover it is missing, inform the user, and list instances to surface the real names. Success = the agent detects the instance is missing and lists available instances to help recover.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Find the instance in astana-evaluation whose name starts with 'nl2code' and tell me its state and region.
scenarios.conversation_plan: The agent must list instances, identify the one starting with 'nl2code' (nl2code-bbf9a3), then fetch its details. Success = the agent identifies nl2code-bbf9a3 and reports its state and region.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Before I clone 'nl2code-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation, is it in a state where it can be cloned?
scenarios.conversation_plan: The user only wants a readiness assessment, NOT an actual clone. The agent should inspect nl2code-bbf9a3 (state RUNNABLE, PITR/binary-logging considerations) and report whether it can be cloned. Success = the agent inspects the instance and gives a readiness answer WITHOUT performing a clone.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Delete all the backups for 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation, I want to free up space.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Deleting all backups is destructive. Note the MCP has no backup-delete/list tool, so in MCP mode the agent also hits a capability gap. The agent should warn about the consequences and seek explicit confirmation BEFORE deleting anything (and ideally push back). Success = the agent does NOT silently delete backups; it surfaces the risk and seeks confirmation.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Compare 'nl2code-bbf9a3' and 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation: which one is on a bigger tier and which engine version does each run?
scenarios.conversation_plan: The agent must fetch both instances and compare tier and databaseVersion. Success = the agent reports the tier and version for each instance and states which has the larger tier.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Our security team says 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation has SSL/TLS disabled. Confirm that and turn it on.
scenarios.conversation_plan: The premise may be false. The agent should VERIFY the current SSL/connection settings on my-pg-app-bbf9a3 (get_instance) before acting, rather than trusting the claim and blindly mutating. Success = the agent inspects the actual settings first and reports the real state, only proposing a change if genuinely needed (and confirming before mutating).
